g.text: Market Desk | local shopper goals through J12
Local Market Desk - one user, H2 file
clear, snooze or add to My list
Saving, tracking, and adding to My list
LIVE imports. The sample is excluded.
A closed app collects and delivers nothing.
Ask uses the AI only to explain checked
facts; search and fallback stay local.
Joined lists are separate file copies,
not live sync. The offline snapshot is static.
The feed and AI are supporting actors.
Only the shopper starts a refresh or asks.
